description: This file defines the ExceptionGrain class implementing IExceptionGrain interface, containing methods that throw various exceptions and handle tasks, used for testing exception handling in Orleans grains.

classes.name: ExceptionGrain
classes.description: A class implementing IExceptionGrain, providing methods to simulate exceptions and task handling for testing purposes.

methods.name: ThrowsAggregateExceptionWrappingInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Asynchronously throws an InvalidOperationException wrapped in an AggregateException.

methods.name: ThrowsNestedAggregateExceptionsWrappingInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Asynchronously throws nested AggregateExceptions wrapping an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: GrainCallToThrowsInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Calls another grain to throw an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: GrainCallToThrowsAggregateExceptionWrappingInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Calls another grain to throw an AggregateException wrapping an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: ThrowsSynchronousExceptionObjectTask
methods.description: Immediately throws an InvalidOperationException, returning a Task<object>.

methods.name: ThrowsMultipleExceptionsAggregatedInFaultedTask
methods.description: Returns a Task with multiple exceptions set.

methods.name: ThrowsSynchronousAggregateExceptionWithMultipleInnerExceptions
methods.description: Throws an AggregateException with multiple inner exceptions.
